title: AEC PBR Materials Chart
description: Twelve common AEC materials displayed on a sphere grid — brick, concrete, limestone, granite, marble, oak, painted plaster, asphalt, polished and brushed steel, copper, and glass — each driven by procedurally-painted colour, normal and metallic-roughness maps. Effects panel exposes IBL, shadows, SAO, bloom, FXAA, tonemap and the new render-mode presets.
